title: Witch Demands Manager
description: A skeletal witch in an ornate purple and gold robe with a pointed hat leans aggressively over a hotel reception desk, pointing her bony finger at a purple-hued female receptionist holding a tablet. The desk features a golden service bell, papers, and floating mathematical symbols. A framed surreal landscape painting with a red portal and bridge hangs on the wall behind them.
prompt: A menacing skeletal witch wearing an elaborate purple and gold patterned robe and tall pointed hat leans over a hotel reception counter, aggressively pointing her long bony finger while speaking. A purple female receptionist in a uniform sits behind the desk holding a tablet. A golden service bell, papers, and floating mathematical symbols fill the air. A framed painting on the wall shows a surreal landscape with a bridge and glowing red portal. Dark, chaotic fantasy atmosphere.
